doc.brief: Evaluates a boolean expression to determine whether to include items.
doc.md: Evaluates a boolean expression to determine whether to include items.

get_expression.brief: Gets the expression that the filter evaluates for each item.
get_expression.md:
Gets the expression that the filter evaluates for
each item.

get_invert.brief: Returns whether the filter inverts the expression.
get_invert.md: Returns whether the filter inverts the expression.

set_expression.brief: Sets the expression that the filter uses to check if items should be filtered.
set_expression.md:
Sets the expression that the filter uses to check if items
should be filtered.

The expression must have a value type of `G_TYPE_BOOLEAN`.

set_invert.brief: Sets whether the filter should invert the expression.
set_invert.md: Sets whether the filter should invert the expression.

expression.brief: The boolean expression to evaluate on each item.
expression.md: The boolean expression to evaluate on each item.

invert.brief: If the expression result should be inverted.
invert.md: If the expression result should be inverted.
